summary: Professional security and code audit performed according to Bug Hunter adversarial protocol. Discovered 1 Critical privilege escalation vulnerability, 4 High severity vulnerabilities (Plaintext credentials in logs, Operator UI lockout, Concurrency stock overdraw, and Negative inventory bug), 7 Medium severity issues, and 4 Low severity flaws.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation via Role Assignment in Register
findings.impact: Unauthenticated users can grant themselves Admin privileges

findings.title: Plaintext Passwords Logged in Audit Trail Table
findings.impact: User passwords visible in plaintext to anyone with audit access

findings.title: Operator Role Locked Out of Core Warehouse Menus in Sidebar Navigation
findings.impact: Operators cannot see or access StockIn, StockOut, Inventory, or Suppliers in UI

findings.title: Stock Overdraw Race Condition in StockOut Transactions
findings.impact: Concurrent requests cause inventory desynchronization and overselling

findings.title: Negative Inventory Stock Permitted on StockIn Quantity Updates
findings.impact: Stock records can drop below zero without validation error

findings.title: Unhandled PrismaClientValidationError and Database Schema Disclosure via sortBy
findings.impact: Internal database structure leaked in 500 error responses

findings.title: JavaScript Syntax Error in Table Action Buttons for Uzbek Names with Apostrophes
findings.impact: Delete button breaks with JavaScript crash on items with apostrophes (e.g. Bo'yoq)

findings.title: Hardcoded http://localhost:3010/api Host Breaks Remote/LAN/Production Use
findings.impact: Clients connecting via IP or domain cannot reach backend API

findings.title: Foreign Key 500 Crash on Deleting Products and Suppliers with Transaction History
findings.impact: Unhandled P2003 error when trying to delete items with stock records

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) on Notifications
findings.impact: Any user can mark other users' notifications as read

findings.title: Mark All Read in Notification Panel is a Mock UI Without Backend API
findings.impact: Notifications are not actually cleared in database

findings.title: Low-Stock Warning Alerts Routed Only to Acting User Instead of Admins
findings.impact: Warehouse administrators miss urgent low-stock warnings

findings.title: Missing Validation on Product Update Allows Negative Prices and NaN Crash
findings.impact: Invalid price inputs cause 500 crash or negative values in database

findings.title: Unused MemoryStore Session Middleware Leaking Memory
findings.impact: Memory leak and unnecessary session overhead

findings.title: Password Reset via Admin Does Not Invalidate Active User Sessions
findings.impact: Compromised account tokens remain valid after password change

findings.title: End Date Filter Truncates Full Day Records in Reports
findings.impact: Transactions made during the selected end date are omitted
